topic: DeepSite: the free open-source AI on Hugging Face that builds a website from one prompt in minutes
details: Reference: youtube.com/shorts/lDQTPOEFnEU (Editminds Tech, 2025-09-04, DeepSite v2). Current truth: DeepSite v4 is migrating into HuggingChat (Make my website + Deploy to Space).
subject: DeepSite: the free open-source AI on Hugging Face that builds a website from one prompt in minutes
audience: iPhone/Mac owners and creators (largest market India) who have seen 'free AI builds your website' reels and want to know if it is real and how to do it
core_value: where Hugging Face's free website builder lives now, the exact steps, and the free-credit catch the hype reels skip
desired_action: save the reel for when they build their site
tone: reporter, plain spoken, no hype; honest about the catch
footage_constraints: HuggingChat and DeepSite need a Hugging Face login, so no live generation recorded by the agent. Official promo (deepsite.hf.co/promo.mp4) + mobile captures of HF pages + chat-ui source. A user screen recording would upgrade the middle.
